净额结算与资格条件
2025年政策问答解释货款与返利、运输相关费用等净额结算情形；部分条款针对优质企业或特定安排，不能把净额到账差额自动认定为手续费。
SAFE explains specified net-settlement cases involving rebates and transport charges, alongside qualification conditions for certain arrangements. The underlying transactions and the applicable banking route need to be identified.
